This site tracks three systematic strategies:

- **[Global Equity Rotation (DCA)](../../strategies/dca.qmd):** ranks 30 country ETFs each week on value, quality, growth and momentum, then goes long the leaders and short the laggards.
- **[Gold Trend](../../strategies/gold.qmd):** a long / flat trend model on gold that switches to a faster horizon when prices become stretched.
- **[Bitcoin Trend](../../strategies/btc.qmd):** a long / flat regime and trend model on BTC/USD.

Every strategy page opens on the **latest signal**: the current position, a chart of the recent signal window and a table of recent signal changes. The **Backtest** tab shows the long-run simulated record.

I'll use the journal for notes on signal changes, market context and model research.
